common.intended_use_statement: ONCOLINK is a research and education prototype. It is not a medical device, does not diagnose cancer, and must not be used for clinical decisions. Only a biopsy can confirm oral cancer. All data comes from public datasets and consenting volunteers.

hints.patient_ref_hint: Enter the 6-digit identification code provided on the paper slip.
